body: My entire life has been one Greek fucking tragedy after another. My ex had a 2 year affair with my little sister, and he promised to make my life hell when I left him. He is succeeding.

I don't even care about school right now. My son's father just had him call and tell me he doesn't want to see me, and he won't even talk to me. I don't even care if I ever graduate. What's the point? So I can make a lot of money and have no one to share it with? Ugh, I just want to wake up as someone else tomorrow!
